pages.text: $(bold)Space will kill you without protection.$(/bold)$(br2)There are three tiers of space-capable armor in this pack. Each enables survival on different planets. Choose based on where you are going.

$(bold)Basic Space Suit$(/bold)$(br)Ad Astra's default suit. Provides oxygen containment and basic protection. Sufficient for the $(bold)Moon$(/bold) and $(bold)Mars$(/bold). Crafted from Netherite and Ad Astra materials.$(br2)$(bold)Netherite Space Suit$(/bold)$(br)Upgraded suit requiring Mars-specific materials. Provides enhanced heat/cold protection. Required for $(bold)Venus$(/bold) and $(bold)Mercury$(/bold) survival.

$(bold)MekaSuit$(/bold)$(br)Mekanism's power armor fills the Jet Suit niche — flight, space survival, and modular upgrades. Already gated behind T4 Mekanism progression. Your primary space exploration armor.$(br2)$(bold)MekaSuit Mk2$(/bold)$(br)The $(italic)ultimate$(/italic) armor in the pack. Crafted from MekaSuit + Aethersteel + Glacio materials + Primordial Essence. The only space armor that accepts Apotheosis affixes, custom enchantments, and socket gems.

$(bold)Note: Jet Suit Removed$(/bold)$(br)Ad Astra's Jet Suit has been removed from the pack. MekaSuit fills this role more appropriately within the progression system. The Jet Suit recipe does not exist.$(br2)$(bold)Soulbound is Critical$(/bold)$(br)Space death penalties are severe (22-30%). Soulbound III on your space suit is almost mandatory for planet exploration.
